items.title: Human Vapor
items.overview: A death on live TV. A culprit who turns to gas. Behind it, a secret project that used and discarded the vulnerable. One detective pursues the dark truth.

items.title: Olivia
items.overview: The country's most famous weatherman must seek refuge from a media storm with his daughter Olivia in his father's olive grove. But having not spoken to him for 30 years won't make returning to his roots easy.

items.title: Worst Neighbor Ever
items.overview: This intense documentary series details true stories of neighbors gone bad, from heinous fraud schemes to senseless acts of violent retribution.

items.title: Heroine? Saint? No, I'm an All-Works Maid (and Proud of It)!
items.overview: Melody may be the heroine and saint destined to save the world from a rising demon king–but all she wants to do is become a perfect maid! Reincarnated in a story-based video game, Melody veers off the set story path, refusing to heed the call to action and instead using her powers to clean. Her new world becomes increasingly chaotic, and the story? Totally unhinged and unpredictable.

items.title: Elle
items.overview: Before Elle Woods was a fish-out-of-water at Harvard, we meet her in 1995 in the tumultuous waters of high school where she encounters tricky friendships, forbidden romance, and questionable fashion choices. In this unexpected chapter of her adolescence, we learn about the experiences that shaped Elle into the iconic young woman we've come to know and love.

items.title: Knot
items.overview: A young man’s life changes forever when a powerful Alpha marks him, binding their fates together in an inescapable bond.

items.title: The Oblivious Saint Can't Contain Her Power
items.overview: Overshadowed by her saintly sister Flora, plain Carolina seizes a chance to be useful by agreeing to political marriage with a prince rumored to be cruel. But the prince is nothing as expected—he’s a gentleman, and Carolina feels valued for once in her life. As Carolina blossoms, she discovers a sense of self-worth and a mysterious power, while Flora’s perfect life back home starts to crumble.

items.title: Adventure Time: Side Quests
items.overview: Young hero Finn and his magical dog best friend Jake embark on adventures across the fantastical land of Ooo — partying with cloud people and punching evil in the butt along the way.

items.title: Kraken: The Black Book of Hours
items.overview: A crime series based on the bestseller *The Black Book of Hours* by Eva García Sáenz de Urturi. Kraken receives a mysterious phone call ordering him to track down a rare, valuable book; if he fails, his mother will be killed. The problem, however, is that his mother has been dead for decades. Together with his inseparable partner Esti, he must solve a complex case filled with suspense, action, and emotion.

items.title: The Eternal Fragrance
items.overview: When the Sea Calamity strikes and the Divine Tree appears, whoever claims its fruit gains power over all creation, sparking a bloody war among the immortals, demons, and monsters. A century later, Lei Xiuyuan seeks out Qingqiu orphan Xiaobangchui to save his brother. Fate brings them to Chufeng Academy, where loyal friends give her warmth and love begins to bloom. As their bond deepens from friendship to something more, the truth of her origins slowly unravels, threatening everything they've built.

items.title: Don't Be Too Emotional
items.overview: A football player befriends a mysterious wish-granter whose dangerous gifts hide secrets that draw them closer together.

items.title: Deep In
items.overview: Filming a daring romance movie, an award-winning actor and an ambitious newcomer lose track of where acting ends and their real desire begins.

items.title: Life, Larry and the Pursuit of Unhappiness: An Almost History of America
items.overview: An improvised, comedic approach to major events in American history in celebration of the 250th anniversary of the founding of the United States.

items.title: Notes from the Last Row
items.overview: A literature professor discovers a student's talent and offers him writing lessons — but as he sinks into the story, their sessions spiral into chaos.

items.title: The Doomies
items.overview: When best friends Bobby and Romy mistakenly open up a gateway to another world, they turn their sleepy coastal town into a hotspot for terrifying creatures of doom. Roped into an epic supernatural mystery, they will cross paths with the so-called “Chosen One” and do battle with both literal and inner monsters.

items.title: The Prosecutor's Proposal
items.overview: A victim’s son and a killer’s son reunite as a prosecutor and investigator, fighting systemic corruption while becoming each other's salvation.

items.title: The American Experiment
items.overview: Life. Liberty. The pursuit of happiness. This sweeping historical documentary series traces how the ideals of America's founders gave rise to a nation.

items.title: The Killings at Parrish Station
items.overview: It’s 1987, and Detective Georgia Cooke is called in to investigate the massacre of four scientists who have been brutally murdered in inexplicable ways, with a lone survivor the obvious suspect. But as Georgia digs deeper, unravelling a complex case entangled in mania, ritual, and the occult, her obsessive quest for the truth spirals into a nightmare that will put her family, career, and sanity on the line.  37 years later, a chilling new spree of murders will pull Georgia back into this nightmare as she confronts the terrifying possibility that the horrors at Parrish Station were never fully buried.

items.title: See You at Work Tomorrow!
items.overview: Cha Ji-yoon is a 7th-year corporate worker who's tired of both work and dating. She crosses paths with Kang Si-woo, the cynical boss with a terrifying reputation. Unexpectedly, she regains spark in her life as she gets to know the kindness behind his stern words. Amid repeated commutes, accidents at work, and failed relationships, the two become each other's irreplaceable anchor.

items.title: The Edge of Horizon
items.overview: Years after being torn apart by rank and tradition, a prince and his first love reunite as buried feelings bloom once more.

items.title: Oasis
items.overview: Oasis is the most luxurious holiday resort in the country — a paradise reserved for the wealthiest families, featuring private beaches, VIP facilities, and impenetrable security. The perfect place to spend the best summer of your life. But everything falls apart when the police storm the resort to investigate a mysterious disappearance. In such an exclusive place, everyone is a suspect — and no one can leave until the culprit is found.

items.title: Never-Ending Summer
items.overview: To save her gravely ill grandmother, top student Zhou Wan approaches her mother's stepson, Lu Xixiao, for funds. They fall for each other over the summer after graduation but are torn apart by misunderstandings in reality. Ten years later, they reunite at work. Though Lu Xixiao harbors resentment, his love for Zhou Wan remains. As they uncover the truth behind a "factory accident," they resolve their differences and reunite.

items.title: Proud
items.overview: When his carefree life is upended by an unexpected family tragedy, Filip is forced to grow up or risk losing all that he has left.

items.title: Raakh
items.overview: When two teenagers vanish, a close-knit family is shattered and the city is left on edge. Determined to uncover the truth, a relentless officer leads a nationwide manhunt that pulls him deep into a world of violence and human depravity.

items.title: The Evil Lawyer
items.overview: When a young attorney is accused of murdering a police officer's son, he teams up with the "Evil Lawyer" to exploit loopholes and prove his innocence.

items.title: Viral Hit
items.overview: A bullied high schooler becomes an overnight sensation after a viral video. But when his newfound fame turns sour, he must learn to fight for himself.

items.title: Archives: The Nanyang Mystery
items.overview: In the early days of the Republic of China, a mysterious murder at sea draws Zhang Haiyan and his partner into an investigation that quickly spirals into a dangerous conspiracy. What begins as a search for truth aboard the massive ship Nan'an becomes a fight for survival in a world of intrigue and betrayal.

items.title: Outlast: The Jungle
items.overview: On a remote tropical island, 16 players must survive the elements, outmaneuver rivals and remain part of a team for a chance to win a $1 million prize.

items.title: Every Year After
items.overview: Six summers to fall in love. One moment to fall apart. A week to get it right. A fun, sweeping, romantic story that asks the question, what if your first love actually was your soulmate?

items.title: The First Jasmine
items.overview: Eldest daughter Ye Li marries the crippled Prince Mo Xiuyao, while her sister Ye Ying weds Prince Mo Jinglei the same day. A descendant of Lishan, Ye Li secretly seeks revenge on those who wronged her clan. Suspected by her husband, who also hides a revenge plan, the couple gradually become allies. Meanwhile, Prince Jinglei plots to seize the throne. In the end, Ye Li and Mo Xiuyao join forces to defeat their enemies and restore peace to the empire.

items.title: Dragon Striker
items.overview: In a world where sports and magic combine, farm boy Key discovers his ultrapowerful natural talent and learns he could be the legendary Dragon Striker.

items.title: Alice and Steve
items.overview: Alice is devastated when her best friend Steve starts dating her 26-year-old daughter Izzy. She's going to lose her best friend and her daughter in one fell swoop. Alice tries everything she can to end the relationship. Unfortunately for her, Steve's more than ready for the attack, and what begins as a perfect friendship, devolves into an all-out feud.

items.title: The Vampire Lestat
items.overview: The Vampire Lestat goes on tour while being haunted by "muses" from his past. As the band's popularity grows, so does Lestat's influence over vampires & humans alike, leaving others to contend with Lestat's power in the face of the Great Conversion.

items.title: The Lie We Lived In
items.overview: While hiding a kidnapped target, a contract killer’s cover unravels when he falls for the detective hunting the truth.

items.title: The Witness
items.overview: With their 2-year-old as the sole witness to her murder, Rachel Nickell's partner fights to protect him amid a flawed investigation.

items.title: Cape Fear
items.overview: When convicted murderer Max Cady is released from prison, he begins infiltrating the family of the married attorneys who helped put him behind bars.

items.title: Michael Jackson: The Verdict
items.overview: Told by key players who were inside the courtroom, this comprehensive documentary dissects the trial of Michael Jackson and his complex legacy.

items.title: Morpheus
items.overview: The story of Piotr Leyer, a lawyer who, through a tragic twist of fate, becomes the head of a criminal gang.

items.title: Ashes to Crown
items.overview: The general's daughter, Chu Zhao, refuses to accept her fate as nothing more than a pawn to be sacrificed in Xiao Xun's rise to power. Taking matters into her own hands, she fights her way out with the help of Xie Yanlai, protecting the emperor's grandson as he makes his way to the emperor's presence. Through a tense standoff in the imperial court, she helps the young prince secure the throne, cutting off Xiao Xun's path to power. But with a new emperor comes new crises. The realm is torn by internal strife and foreign threats. Working alongside Xie Yanlai, Chu Zhao navigates the treacherous currents of the court, leads troops into battle, and ultimately rewrites her own destiny, sparing the people of the State of Chu from the ravages of war.

items.title: Not Suitable for Work
items.overview: Follow five work-obsessed twenty-somethings striving for professional success and, if they have time, personal happiness in Manhattan's most glamorous neighborhood, Murray Hill.

items.title: The Trio
items.overview: Middle-aged Hugo encounters his childhood loves' daughter, sending him back to when his younger self begins college. His memories offer a glimpse into a deeply entwined and emotionally complex story of yearning, as a love triangle becomes increasingly complicated. Tracing the emotional journeys of lead characters Hugo, Thora, and August.

items.title: Doctor on the Edge
items.overview: In South Korea, military service is mandatory for all men. But a select few—like privileged medical students—can serve as public health doctors instead. This is the story of those privileged few. Do Ji-ui, a plastic surgeon, is assigned to Pyeondong-do, an isolated island no one wants to go to. From the very first day, ominous signs begin to appear. Can he survive a full year on this hellish island and make it out alive—or will the island break him before he can hold the line?

items.title: Torn Apart
items.overview: Aras, a fearless seventeen-year-old boy, comes to Bodrum to search for his younger sibling, the only remaining member of his family whom he lost at the age of five. His new life in Bodrum will turn into a challenging struggle when his path crosses with the Akkaya family, the most powerful family in the city.

items.title: Tip Toe
items.overview: An ordinary Manchester suburb becomes a minefield of lies and violence when Leo gives neighbour Clive his spare key.

items.title: Payback
items.overview: A grieving debt collector enters the entertainment world for revenge, only to fall into a dangerous attraction with a powerful executive.

items.title: Reborn Rookie
items.overview: After a powerful conglomerate chairman is betrayed by his children and wakes up in the body of a young soccer player, he uses his business genius and athletic physique to seek ultimate revenge against his family.

items.title: Ticket to Heaven
items.overview: A grieving student pursuing priesthood faces a crisis of faith when he falls for a troubled new classmate in a world ruled by strict dogma.

items.title: Chasing Love
items.overview:
Song, a hot nerd and food researcher, arranged a one-night stand with a mysterious woman under a strict condition: no strings attached. However, the other party broke the terms, asking for an emotional connection. Song ended the steamy encounter and walked away.

But the world really is round. That woman turned out to be Piangrawin—the daughter of the president of the company where Song worked. And Piangrawin wasn’t letting go easily. She pursued her with puppy-like devotion, entangling Song's heart and routine with reckless charm. She even claimed she’d already named their future child.

items.title: Brazil '70: The Third Star
items.overview: In 1970, the Brazilian national team took the field with big dreams and an even bigger challenge: to become the first three-time world champions.

items.title: Star City
items.overview: Step into a thrilling chapter inspired by For All Mankind. Same alt-history universe. Different perspective: the Soviet Union's. Go behind the Iron Curtain with the cosmonauts, engineers, and intelligence officers who risked it all in the race for the Moon.

items.title: My 2 Cents
items.overview: When his friend Wild Boar lands himself in hot water with organized crime, Zero and the gang unite to save him while barely coping with their own lives.

items.title: World War II with Tom Hanks
items.overview: Explores WWII from Germany's invasion of Poland through the atomic age, examining pivotal battles, wartime leaders like Churchill and Roosevelt, and the human cost of total war.

items.title: Sofia the First: Royal Magic
items.overview: Follow Sofia as she attends The Charmswell School for Royal Magic, where she discovers she is the most magical princess in the realm and must learn how to master her powers while making new royal friends.

items.title: Dear England
items.overview: Haunted by decades of failures, Gareth Southgate becomes England manager and uses psychology to confront fear and pursue victory.

items.title: Two Weeks in August
items.overview: A Greek holiday with friends to relax and reconnect. But when Zoe acts on her desires, heaven quickly turns into hell. Witty, painfully relatable drama starring Jessica Raine.

items.title: Futuro desierto
items.overview: A robotics engineer moves with his family to Mexico to secretly test humanoid androids, investigating the emotional dilemmas and clashes between humans and artificial beings.

items.title: Mating Season
items.overview: A cast of bears, raccoons, deer, foxes and a host of other horny, lovable forest critters navigate love, sexual relationships and the universal need to hook up and find a partner.

items.title: Ravalear: Not for Sale
items.overview: In Barcelona’s Raval neighbourhood, the family-run restaurant “Can Mosques” faces eviction after an investment fund buys the building. The family’s fight to survive escalates, pushing them to cross any and all boundaries.

items.title: James.
items.overview: James Rodríguez, Colombia's legendary No. 10, shares details of his journey to football's elite and the game's biggest stage.

items.title: The Boroughs
items.overview: In a seemingly perfect retirement community, a crew of unlikely heroes must stop an otherworldly threat from stealing the one thing they don't have: time.

items.title: Carizzma
items.overview: Caro Pardíaco, a sparkling influencer and full-time diva, has it all – but at thirty, in the midst of a midlife crisis, she falls into the trap of romantic love.

items.title: Kylie
items.overview: A look at the life of Australian pop star Kylie Minogue, who opens her personal archives and reflects on a career in which she has sold 80 million records and reinvented herself, and by extension pop, several times. Home movies, personal photographs and new interviews reveal the picture, as Kylie addresses how she’s faced public scrutiny, personal loss and illness.

items.title: Maximum Pleasure Guaranteed
items.overview: A newly divorced mom falls down a dangerous rabbit hole of blackmail, murder, and youth soccer.

items.title: You're Killing Me
items.overview: In a quaint New England town, bestselling novelist Allie forms an unlikely alliance with aspiring writer and podcaster Andi to find the killer of a close friend.

items.title: Guardián de mi vida
items.overview: Sofía Peralta-Avitia Villaseñor, a successful businesswoman and great mother, who feels lonely in her marriage to Gonzalo Balmori-Ricci Nava. At the same time, her daughter, Bárbara Balmori-Ricci Peralta-Avitia, and her young bodyguard, Salvador "Chava" Reyes Encino, will transform their rebelliousness into passion. But none of them know that the evil, ambitious people around them will try to meddle in their paths on their road to love.

items.title: Summer '36
items.overview: Nice, 1936. As workers enjoy their first paid holidays, four very different women become entangled in the murder of a prosecutor at the Riviera hotel.

items.title: The Air
items.overview: When a violent coup erupts back home, Princess Catherine Blew De Laina becomes an assassination target while visiting Thailand. Her survival falls entirely on Lieutenant 'Lom' Vayo Watinwanich, a sharp female marine police officer assigned as her underground protector. Forced off the grid, the two women must navigate relentless tactical hits and political betrayal. As duty and survival blur, their isolation sparks an intense, undeniable magnetic attraction—a forbidden love defying rigid military protocol and royal expectations. Amidst constant gunfire, Blew finds safety in Lom's embrace, while Lom discovers a kindred spirit beneath the royal exterior. In a world where everyone has a price, their fierce devotion becomes both their ultimate liability and their only way out. Together, they must dismantle the conspiracy before the assassins close in.

items.title: Nemesis
items.overview: A relentless LAPD cop becomes obsessed with taking down the master thief behind a string of daring heists — and only one can come out on top.

items.title: Soul Mate
items.overview: In a moment of despair, Ryu Narutaki finds himself saved by Korean boxer Johan Hwang. As their wounded souls draw closer, their fates cruelly intertwine.

items.title: Between Father and Son
items.overview: In just a few suspenseful minutes, a lawyer's world tilts as her visit to her fiancé's family estate ignites an irresistible bond with her future stepson.

items.title: When Oranges Fall
items.overview: In the 90s, two polar-opposite classmates with the same nickname find their mutual dislike turning to love after a stray orange brings them together.

items.title: Zhan Zhao Adventures
items.overview: Zhan Zhao, a fourth-ranked imperial guard, embarks on a solo investigation after receiving evidence of a cold case. Along the way, he encounters the strong-willed Miss Huo Linglong and the justice-driven Bai Yutang. The three like-minded companions join forces to uncover clues, uphold justice, and capture criminals. Together, they work to expose a dangerous web of power that has infiltrated both the court and the martial world, ultimately restoring peace to the people.

items.title: The Legend of Kitchen Soldier
items.overview: A plastic-spoon man is on his way to becoming a legendary army cook—uncovering dark secrets within the base through his cooking skills.

items.title: Regular Show: The Lost Tapes
items.overview: Familiar duo Mordecai and Rigby navigate mundane park jobs that inevitably spiral into surreal, chaotic disasters.

items.title: Believe Me
items.overview: The horrific true story of John Worboys, one of the most notorious serial rapists in British history. His modus operandi was to tell women in his cab that he’d won some money and then persistently offer them a glass of champagne, which he’d laced with drugs, and which rendered his victims unconscious. He was convicted in 2009 for sexually assaulting 12 women between 2006 and 2008, with their cases selected from a large number of suspected further victims.

items.title: Rosa Elettrica - In fuga con il nemico
items.overview: Maria Chiara Giannetta plays Rosa Valera, a young agent recently transferred to the Witness Protection Unit. On her first assignment, she's assigned to Cocìss (Francesco Di Napoli), an unpredictable Camorra baby-boss who recently repented.

items.title: Double Helix
items.overview: Years after being torn apart by family and fate, two former lovers reunite as boss and employee, forced to confront a love they can't escape.

items.title: My Royal Nemesis
items.overview: A Joseon-era villain doomed to die opens her eyes in modern-day Seoul — where a ruthless chaebol heir may be her last chance to rewrite her fate.

items.title: The Terror: Devil in Silver
items.overview: Wrongfully committed to New Hyde Psychiatric Hospital, one man faces secretive doctors, dangerous patients, and something even worse …

items.title: Buonvino - Misteri a Villa Borghese
items.overview: Deputy commissioner Giovanni Buonvino is transferred to command the Villa Borghese police station. While the assignment initially seems like a joke, he soon discovers that the park is a microcosm rich in secrets, crimes, and mysteries.

items.title: M.I.A.
items.overview: Restless in the Florida Keys, Etta Tiger Jonze dreams of a life in Miami's glittering, sub-tropical kingdom. When her family's drug-running business shatters in tragedy, however, Etta embarks on a dangerous journey through Miami's neon-lit underbelly that will define who she is and what she's ultimately capable of.

items.title: Legends
items.overview: As drugs flood the streets of '90s Britain, a team of civil servants is thrust undercover to topple the gangs behind it.

items.title: Star Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu | A Special Look
items.overview: Get ready for "Star Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu | A Special Look," only in theaters.

items.title: Born with Luck
items.overview: Zhang Yi'ang, a veteran detective, is sent to Sanjiangkou to investigate a case but soon finds himself caught in a web of crime and corruption. While pursuing a powerful criminal network, he unexpectedly receives help from a group of bungling thieves, who inadvertently aid his mission to unravel the truth behind a murder.

items.title: Enemies with Benefits
items.overview: Head of Sales Lal is determined to triumph over Head of Accounting Wine. Wine is her polar opposite and known for her mercilessness. When a wild night leads them to a friends with benefits relationship, they'll do anything to keep it a secret, pretending to be enemies so that absolutely no one at work finds out. Without realising it, however, their newfound closeness begins to give way to love.

items.title: A Splendid Match
items.overview: After years away from her family, Gu Jinzhao returns home and begins a remarkable transformation, from a carefree young woman into a poised and influential noble lady. As questions of marriage arise, she refuses to follow tradition and holds firmly to her own beliefs about love. But when multiple men enter her life, each offering a different future, who will Gu Jinzhao choose?

items.title: The Grand-ish Tour
items.overview: Gathering in the care home where they now live, Jeremy Clarkson, Richard Hammond and James May host three special shows looking back at their favourite Grand Tour moments. Or at least the ones they can remember. Their fading memories stretch from California to Mongolia to Italy and everywhere in between, and include classic moments of misery featuring mud, water, and at least two actual injuries.

items.title: Tan cerca de ti, nace el amor
items.overview: After her newborn daughter is taken from her and given up for adoption, journalist Verónica Arellano spends years searching for her. When tragedy leaves the girl's adoptive family shattered, Verónica assumes a new identity to stay close to her daughter, setting in motion a story of love, family, and long-buried secrets.

items.title: Prisoner
items.overview: A young and ambitious prison officer finds herself in the middle of a battle for the criminal underworld as crime lords try to evade justice. But in order to do that, she will have to learn quickly to put her faith in one of the very men she wants to put behind bars.

items.title: Man on Fire
items.overview: Haunted by his past and hunted by his enemies, a Special Forces veteran fights to keep a teenage girl alive on the deadly streets of Rio de Janeiro.

items.title: New Zealand Spy
items.overview: The New Zealand Intelligence Agency’s on the hunt for new recruits. When the agency places an ad in the newspaper, only three decidedly unlikely candidates respond. Thrown headfirst into the murky world of espionage, the mismatched trio fumbles its way through betrayal, romance and escalating absurdity.

items.title: Should I Marry a Murderer?
items.overview: In 2020, pathologist Caroline Muirhead's fiancé, Scottish farmer Alexander 'Sandy' McKellar, confessed to her that he and his twin brother Robert had killed cyclist Tony Parsons in a 2017 hit-and-run on the A82 near Bridge of Orchy and buried the body on the Auch Estate.

items.title: Gold Land
items.overview: A young woman working as an airport security agent accidentally comes into possession of a smuggling ring’s gold bars. Caught in a chaotic whirlwind of greed and betrayal among various parties vying for the gold, she becomes consumed by the desire to claim it all for herself.

items.title: The House of the Spirits
items.overview: The epic tale of a proud and passionate family, secret loves, and bloody revolution. The Trueba family's passions, struggles, and secrets span a century of violent social change, culminating in a crisis that hurls the proud, tyrannical patriarch and his beloved granddaughter towards opposite sides of the fence.

items.title: Half Man
items.overview: When Niall's estranged 'brother' Ruben shows up at his wedding, it leads to an explosion of violence that catapults us back through their lives.

items.title: Unconditional
items.overview: A mother-daughter vacation abroad takes a devastating turn when Gali is arrested for drug possession. Refusing to accept the charges, her mother Orna risks everything on a quest for freedom—only to get entangled in a web of Gali's secrets.

items.title: Straight to Hell
items.overview: As Japan's most famous fortune teller, Kazuko Hosoki ruled TV and bestseller lists, but who was she behind rumors of spiritual scams and underworld ties?

items.title: Secret Service
items.overview: A British intelligence officer Kate Henderson races against time to uncover a UK politician's potential ties with the Kremlin, risking her reputation and family, as a murder and election loom.

items.title: The Cage
items.overview: When Leanne and Matty discover they are both robbing from the safe at the inner-city casino they work in, their lives are set on a collision course; with each other, the local gangster they're stealing from, and the police.

items.title: Filing for Love
items.overview: A romantic comedy about Joo In-ah, a charismatic audit department head with a secret, and Noh Ki-joon, the department's ace who is suddenly demoted to deal with the company's scandals.

items.title: Sociedade da Virtude: A Série
items.overview: Learn the origins of our heroes who unite against a terrible threat: a billionaire with his megacorporation, trying to take over the world!

items.title: Radar
items.overview: The year is 1988. A mysterious object is falling in the vicinity of a small Soviet town located in the area of a powerful missile defense system radar. The most ordinary sixth graders Lech, Tolya and Sema go in search of a meteorite in anticipation of fame and fame. While wandering through the forest, Lech gets lost. His search in the forest by police forces starts a chain of events that lead to the contact of one of the locals with something very strange.

items.title: Fake Fact Lips
items.overview: Lifelong rivals Ryo and Zen take their office war to a new level — the first one to make the other fall in love wins the ultimate bet.

items.title: Love of Silom
items.overview: A heartbroken cop hiding a forbidden love finds a second chance at love when he rescues a struggling student at a nightclub in Silom.

items.title: Naughty Business
items.overview: When her husband falls into a coma, Nines, a traditional housewife, transforms the family business into the first adult video store in Valladolid.

items.title: Flunked
items.overview: Eddy, a math genius and small-time crook, avoids jail-time by going undercover as a teacher. His mission: to identify the kid of a major criminal.

items.title: Stranger Things: Tales from '85
items.overview: Winter. Hawkins. 1985. Welcome back to a town crawling with secrets, where beloved heroes are facing fresh mysteries... and an all-new breed of strange.

items.title: Hulk Hogan: Real American
items.overview: Before he was Hulk Hogan, he was Terry Bollea. Uncover the man behind the legend in this unfiltered documentary featuring his very last interview.

items.title: This Is a Gardening Show
items.overview: Zach Galifianakis digs into the world of gardening, interviewing curious kids and eccentric experts in a funny, oddball celebration of the food we eat.

items.title: Sold Out on You
items.overview: A work-obsessed cosmetics CEO and a top home-shopping host struggling with insomnia cross paths, and through an unexpected romance, begin to heal the emptiness in their lives.

items.title: Unchosen
items.overview: When a young mother from a sheltered cult crosses paths with a mysterious stranger, she embarks on a risky affair that awakens desires and dark secrets.

items.title: Mazatlán Shore
items.overview: A new family coast is appreciated on the coast of Mazatlán, one of our band rhythms, a wave of reggaeton and a reggaeton that experiences the animals at the party, and also the transformation of this city.

items.title: The Scarecrow
items.overview: A fiercely competitive police officer and an idealistic prosecutor, former high school classmates, reunite while investigating a nationwide serial murder case, pulling them into both a dangerous pursuit and an unresolved personal past.

items.title: Kevin
items.overview: A life-long housecat decides that he doesn’t want to live with people anymore. Loosely inspired by a real break-up and the cat caught in the middle, Kevin dares to ask himself, "Is there a world where I don’t do the owner thing and am just… single for the rest of my life?"

items.title: Mint
items.overview: Shannon is the only daughter of an infamous crime family that rules the region, a real-life princess who has never wanted for anything. But when she meets Arran, a member of a rival gang, their whirlwind romance begins to unravel the world she’s always known.

items.title: We Are All Trying Here
items.overview: An aspiring director hits rock bottom after 20 years chasing his debut — until he meets an overwhelmed producer who helps him rediscover his self-worth.

items.title: Absolute Value of Romance
items.overview: High schooler Yeo Eui-ju secretly writes web novels by night. When four charming new teachers arrive, they inspire her stories and shake up her school.

items.title: Dandelion
items.overview: At an afterlife agency where angels guide lingering souls, Tetsuo and Misaki take on any challenge to help the dead find peace in their own offbeat style.

items.title: Ronaldinho: The One and Only
items.overview: This series follows the life and career of Brazilian soccer star Ronaldinho, tracing his journey from young prodigy to global sports icon.

items.title: Made with Love
items.overview: To save the family business, ambitious chef Luka must team up with newcomer Dennis when he joins her mother's restaurant. The only catch? She hates him.

items.title: Someone Has to Know
items.overview: A boy vanishes, and no one can find him. An open-and-shut case, except there are no leads. Three hundred people around him, and no one saw anything?

items.title: The Dark Wizard
items.overview: An unflinching portrait of Dean Potter, the world's most influential and controversial climber, base jumper and highline walker, who achieves jaw-dropping feats while battling his inner demons.

items.title: Reborn
items.overview: An arrogant IT tycoon is reincarnated as a struggling dry cleaner in the past, using his future knowledge to find his killer while rediscovering his humanity.

items.title: I Want to End This Love Game
items.overview: Childhood friends Yukiya and Miku share everything…except their feelings. Ever since sixth grade, they've played a "love game": they take turns saying "I love you" and whoever gets flustered first loses. Now in high school, their hearts are closer than ever—but will they finally find the courage to confess?

items.title: The Classroom of a Black Cat and a Witch
items.overview: Spica Virgo dreams of joining a magical academy, but there’s one problem: She can’t use magic! With no mentor or connections, her chances seem slim—until a mysterious talking black cat appears. A powerful mage cursed into feline form, he agrees to teach her in exchange for help breaking the spell. As their secret pact begins, Spica steps into a world of magic, mystery, and unexpected surprises.

items.title: Ichijyoma Mankitsu Gurashi!
items.overview: Meiko Morita is chosen to transfer into an elite all-girls academy and moves to Tokyo to live in the student dormitory. To her surprise, the dorm also operates as a manga cafe - and she finds herself working there alongside the other residents. This is the beginning of Meiko's new life in a tiny one-tatami room!

items.title: La nena
items.overview: Months after the events of The Purple Network, the hunt is not over yet. Following Lucas's death, Elena Blanco has disappeared. Only Mariajo knows where she is, but she keeps it a secret, even from the rest of the team. The fight against The Network has taken too much of a toll on her, and in a desperate attempt to get her life back on track, she has left the BAC.

items.title: KILL BLUE
items.overview: Legendary hitman Juzo Ogami has never failed an assignment. But after a mission, he’s stung by a mysterious wasp and wakes up in the body of a 13-year-old boy! And to make things even weirder, he receives a bizarre new order: infiltrate a middle school. Now the once-feared assassin must balance the chaos of school life with his deadly work, all while searching for a way to regain his adult body!

items.title: Fist of the North Star: HOKUTO NO KEN
items.overview: In the year 199X, the world was engulfed in nuclear fire!! Yet...humanity somehow survived!! A lone man with seven scars on his chest emerges. His name is Kenshiro, heir to Hokuto Shinken. In a world where only the strong survive, Kenshiro forges a path with his iron fists!

items.title: Yowayowa Sensei
items.overview: Hiyori Hiwamura is known as the "Scary Teacher," and if you offend her, she'll put a curse on you! Or at least that's what everyone believes. She's secretly a total softy who's deeply misunderstood, and once you see her sweet side, she'll put a different kind of spell on you.

items.title: Botan Kamiina Fully Blossoms When Drunk
items.overview: New university life, new dormmates…and a whole new world of drinks! Botan Kamiina takes her first sip of alcohol after spotting the quiet dorm leader, Ibuki Tonami, enjoying a highball alone. From shochu to whisky, Botan shares the joy of drinking with friends, while Ibuki slowly learns that some pleasures are better when shared.

items.title: A Hundred Scenes of AWAJIMA
items.overview: At Awajima Opera School, girls from across Japan strive to earn a place on stage. Wakana is driven by her love of musical theater, while Kinue studies with quiet discipline. Scholarship student Emi draws attention from all—but especially from Keiko, who struggles with admiration and comparison. Through shifting perspectives, their intertwined days explore ambition, friendship, and self-discovery.

items.title: Uno sbirro in Appennino
items.overview: Inspector Vasco Benassi is known in Bologna as the “best cop,” but after making a mistake, he is sent to the Apennines, to the small village of Muntagò, the hometown he had left years earlier following a traumatic loss. Investigating various cases will help him reconnect with his roots, in a process of “reopening his heart” that will lead him to become less solitary, to form new relationships, and to deepen others from the past.

items.title: Big Mistakes
items.overview: Blackmailed into working for some very dangerous people, two deeply incapable siblings become the most disorganized duo in organized crime.

items.title: The Warrior Princess and the Barbaric King
items.overview: Serafina, the West’s fiercest knight, expected torture when captured by barbarians. Instead, she got a marriage proposal! Marrying her sworn enemy is a hard no! But after seeing her wedding captor’s culture and very pretty face, she may be tempted to swap her sword for a wedding veil. Get ready for the ultimate enemies-to-maybe-lovers arc.

items.title: Bandi
items.overview: Following the death of their mother, their pillar of strength and their anchor, eleven siblings aged 7 to 23 try to stay united in the face of adversity. But for some of them, drug trafficking seems to be the only way to survive. A decision far from being unanimously accepted, and one that severely tests the strength of their family bonds.

items.title: The Miniature Wife
items.overview: Lindy and Les, a married writer and scientist, are forced to re-evaluate the power balances in their relationship after a freak accident shrinks Lindy down to 6 inches tall.

items.title: Michael Jackson: An American Tragedy
items.overview: Charting Michael Jackson’s journey from child prodigy to global icon, examining the genius, controversy, trials and tragedy that shaped and continue to divide his legacy.

items.title: Trust Me: The False Prophet
items.overview: In this true-crime documentary, a cult expert and filmmaker infiltrate a polygamist sect to expose a self-proclaimed prophet and bring him to justice.

items.title: My Ribdiculous Reincarnation
items.overview: A man stuck in endless reincarnation avoids long waits for heroic roles by rebirthing into absurd forms—from a hermit crab to a vegetable and even an explosive.

items.title: Gals Can't Be Kind to Otaku!?
items.overview: Takuya Seo is a quiet otaku who keeps a low profile at school—until two gals from his class start talking to him. The cool but scatterbrained Kei Amane and the cheerful, energetic Kotoko Ijichi couldn’t be more different, but the three soon bond over anime, games, and shared fandom. But one question remains: do nice gals who hang out with otaku really exist?!

items.title: Pardon the Intrusion, I'm Home!
items.overview: Rinko, a quiet office worker and secret otaku, just wants to enjoy her anime in peace. But when a neighbor keeps banging on the wall, she asks her other neighbor, Satsuki, for help. Their attempt to resolve the issue goes wrong, leaving a hole in the wall that reveals…Usaharu-sensei, the creator of Rinko’s favorite manga?! Now with nowhere to hide, their lives begin to overlap in surprising ways!

items.title: Eren the Southpaw
items.overview: As high school reaches its midpoint, Koichi Asakura—who dreams of studying design at art school—has his plans shaken by explosive graffiti on a museum wall. The artist is Eren Yamagishi, a left-handed girl who buried her talent after a past incident. Drawn together by art, Koichi pursues design as Eren returns to painting, but fear, ambition, and old scars threaten their paths.

items.title: Life in Smokey Blue
items.overview: Struggling salesman Sakutaro reunites with his sharp-tongued former rival Kuji, reigniting a buried one-night spark from eight years ago.

items.title: Unexpectedly Naughty Fukami
items.overview: Office rivals Kaji and Fukami find their professional masks slipping during a business trip that turns a simple stay into a heated affair.

items.title: Marriage Toxin
items.overview: For centuries, the deadly arts have been perfected by Masters, and Five Great Families hold the greatest power and influence. Hikaru Gero, an heir to the Gero family, lives in the underworld as an elite assassin. When his sister is pressured to produce an heir, Hikaru asks Mei Kinosaki, a brilliant marriage swindler, to find him a bride. The most challenging mission of his life begins!

items.title: LIAR GAME
items.overview: When Nao Kanzaki receives a strange letter and a suitcase containing 100 million yen, she learns that she has been selected to participate in the LIAR GAME. In this high-stakes psychological battle, lies, deception, and betrayal reign supreme. Naïve and honest, Nao turns to Shinichi Akiyama, a brilliant former con artist, to survive the twisted game. In a game built on lies, can honesty prevail?

items.title: I Made Friends with the Second Prettiest Girl in My Class
items.overview: Maki Maehara, the class outcast, finally makes his first friend: Umi Asanagi, the second-prettiest girl in class and the center of everyone’s attention. He’s convinced she’s out of his league, but as their unlikely friendship grows, Maki starts to wonder…could there be more than just friendship between them?

items.title: Even a Replica Can Fall in Love
items.overview: Nao is a replica created to be Sunao Aikawa’s perfect double, stepping in whenever Sunao skips school. She studies, plays sports, and lives each day for the original—until one day, Nao falls in love. Suddenly, her quiet, borrowed life blooms with secret dates and shy promises. But the more she cherishes them, the more she must hide from Sunao, who’s starting to notice the changes in her replica.

items.title: Marika's Love Meter Malfunction
items.overview: Now I can see how much my crush likes me. I lack the courage to confess to my childhood friend, Marika. One day, I make a strong wish upon a shooting star: To read someone's feelings like in a dating sim. The very next day, much to my surprise, that wish came true…?! Lovemeters now appear over the girls in my class. Confused by this surreal sight, I check Marika's, only to find her meter's plummeted to the rotten depths of hell...?! Marika, if you hate me, then why were you always so kind...? What are Marika's hidden true feelings? Does she really hate me, or...?!
